description:
Childcare centres and preschools or kindergartens (schools are served separately): counts in the suburb, rates per 1,000 residents and distance from the suburb centre to the nearest of each.

Coverage: All Australian suburbs and localities. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/education-and-childcare`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: count_childcare, per_1000_childcare, nearest_km_childcare, count_preschools, per_1000_preschools, nearest_km_preschools, count_total, per_1000_total, per_km2_total. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_amenities_education_and_childcare
title: Suburb · Childcare and early learning
